rationale: The entity is profitable and profit before tax is positive, but revenue is the stable measure of the scale of the business and the configured 1% example for revenue in ASA 320 A8 is appropriate. It produces a threshold of AUD 120,000.00, which is low relative to the receivables movement and keeps the preliminary analysis focused.
counter_argument: Profit before tax is stable and positive, so 5% of profit before tax (AUD 75,000.00) is a genuine alternative and would be slightly lower than the revenue threshold. It is not preferred because revenue is less affected by the period-end accounting estimates and the 1% revenue example is expressly given in ASA 320 A8.
